value.rationale: Theorem 3.8 is presented as a characterization that collapses a two-control continuous g-fusion frame to a one-control product form. The counterexample shows that this reduction can destroy even reality of the defining quadratic form in dimension two. The repair identifies the exact operator interchange used by the proof and supplies a natural commutation hypothesis already recognized elsewhere in the same source.
